title: 茶水间英文 - 11月7日 | 白宫换将、AI巨头降价、哥斯拉破纪录
description:
Trump just named Stephen Miller his new White House chief of staff days after losing Congress in the midterms, investors are telling Anthropic to cut its giant IPO price tag, and Godzilla Minus Zero is smashing a twenty-year-old box office record. Alex and Jordan turn all three into lines you can steal for small talk.

特朗普在中期选举丢掉国会几天后，就任命斯蒂芬·米勒为新任白宫幕僚长；投资者要求 Anthropic 下调其巨额 IPO 估值；新片《哥斯拉 Minus Zero》则打破了保持二十多年的票房纪录。本期 Alex 和 Jordan 把这三条新闻都聊成了能直接拿去跟朋友说的口语。

Words to steal 生词本：
- chief of staff — 白宫幕僚长；最高幕僚
- shake-up — 大换血；人事大调整
- double down — 加倍下注；变本加厉
- valuation — 估值
- pushback — 反对；抵制
- rout — 溃败；暴跌
- smash a record — 打破纪录
- blockbuster — 票房大片
